Three related slices of Phase 3 of KEL witness receipts (audit #12 F4, invariant M3), batched into one PR per CLAUDE.md's workflow ritual since each built directly on the last in the same session before the branch was ever pushed. D-0328: did_mini::assess_kel_assurance classifies Direct/Pinned/Witnessed/WitnessedRecent/DuplicityDetected by composing Kel::verify (via FreshnessPins) with a caller-supplied WitnessedEventCertificate/WitnessPolicy and known_duplicity flag. D-0329: WitnessJournal::observe_verified runs the real Kel::verify chain over the entire presented KEL before delegating to observe, closing the 'trusts the caller' gap observe's own doc comment named. Still open: WitnessPolicy read from a real Establishment event, persistence/gossip for the registry, a bounded/incremental re-verify, and any real call site gating an authority decision or feeding real proofs into the registry. Closed independently by both the issue #192 and issue #194 branches after PR #191 was confirmed merged.

Follow-up to D-0327: Backend::list_meta_prefix_last, a genuinely bounded 'most recent N' query. MemoryBackend gets a real O(log n + limit) BTreeMap::range(...).rev().take(limit) implementation; FsBackend inherits the trait's non-bounded default (deliberately -- a real bounded FS reverse walk needs either a sorted early-stopping traversal or an on-disk sorted index, not attempted here to avoid risking FsBackend's existing symlink/path-traversal defenses). Store::recent now calls the new method directly instead of since(0) reversed/truncated client-side. Store::since's own forward scan is unchanged and still not bounded. Closed here (PR #179 branch, during its rebase past main) since PR #193 was confirmed merged; found stale (still in_review) and closed per the standing precedent of closing merged-but-unclosed claims on the next PR that touches this file.
